⏱️ TimingTap

A precision timing challenge: a moving indicator passes through a target zone and you must tap at the precise moment it aligns. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Watch the indicator move back and forth or around a dial.
  2. Tap when the indicator is precisely in the target zone.
  3. The closer to the center of the target, the more points you score.
  4. Timing windows get smaller as levels increase.
  5. Stay relaxed and watch the rhythm — don't anticipate, react.
